treatment_summary.value: Anti-infective treatment with meropenem and vancomycin (3 days, no response); intravenous immunoglobulin 2 g/kg (fever recurred after 2 days); glutathione and glycyrrhizin hepatoprotective therapy; intravenous methylprednisolone 4 mg/kg/day from day 14 of admission, reduced to 2 mg/kg/day; on readmission supportive therapy and IV methylprednisolone 2 mg/kg/day reduced to 1.5 mg/kg/day; then oral methylprednisolone with gradual dose reduction, maintenance 0.5 mg/kg/day. Biologic agents not administered; symptoms controlled with glucocorticoid monotherapy.

clinical_diagnosis_basis.value: Autoinflammatory disease suspected after negative infectious work-up; whole-exome sequencing found a heterozygous TNFAIP3 mutation (de novo by parental Sanger sequencing); 'Based on this heterozygous TNFAIP3 mutation, the patient was diagnosed with A20 haploinsufficiency (HA20).'

parental_testing_statement.value: Sanger sequencing confirmed that neither parent carried the variant (Figure 4), indicating a de novo frameshift mutation.
